acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Wolves family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Pack Alpha, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Prey-Marking Champion archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Broad mature wolf with a torn ear, deep neck mantle, dominant upright posture, and accumulated scars rather than armor.
Signature mechanic: Marked Quarry: a visible scent trail binds the Alpha's intercept to one target until terrain or distance breaks the line.
battlefieldDuty: Mark one target, intercept attacks aimed at lesser Wolves, and swap the active pursuit wing after every lunge.
constructionDimensions: Saturated streaming fur, reflective hide, coherent droplets, and visible currents along the legs preserve the solid wolf beneath.
Throat, paw, and scent-mark actions drive narrow pressure flows whose direction matches the family mechanic.
counterplay: Cross strong terrain to break the scent line or bait the intercept away before attacking the lesser Wolves. Affinity signal: Water drains from the committed shoulder or throat channel after release, exposing the same physical punish window as Normal.
forbiddenTreatments: Amorphous liquid wolf without a structural core
Opaque spray that hides limbs, gaze, or tail alignment
identityInvariants: Every form retains a four-legged lupine skeleton, long muzzle, visible paws, expressive ears, and a readable tail; no form becomes humanoid or wears manufactured armor.
Rank is communicated through chest mass, coat mantle, scars, posture, and pack behavior rather than arbitrary glow or simple scale.
Pack attack direction remains readable through gaze, ear position, tail line, paw placement, and the spacing of companion Wolves.
telegraph: Its tail locks level, nose paints a visible scent line, and one foreleg braces toward the marked target.
